subject.title: feat(webchat): rare lobster pet variants incl. retro homage to the classic logo

question: Should OpenClaw accept expanding the sidebar lobster pet with the new rare palette ladder and retro logo homage in core Web UI?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and review-clean, but the change is visual brand/product direction and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Land after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the rare variants as Web UI polish once the branch is current and required checks remain green.

options.title: Narrow the variants
options.body: Ask for fewer or adjusted variants if the retro or rarity tone is too much for the product surface.

options.title: Pause the polish
options.body: Keep the existing six-palette pet and close or rework this PR if maintainers do not want more mascot variance now.

recommendation.title: Land after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the rare variants as Web UI polish once the branch is current and required checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current lobster pet and authored this visual follow-up, so he is the clearest routing owner for the brand/product choice.
